name: MFP 8 zone repeater extender card
family: Context Plus MFP Range Conventional Panels
summary: The FF596R is an 8 Zone Extender PCB designed to extend the zones on the Context Plus MFP Repeater panel part FF596. The Context Plus MFP Repeater panel part FF596 is fitted with one 8 Zone Extender PCB (Part No. FF596R) when supplied. The FF596 Repeater panel can be expanded to 32 zone in multiples of eight by installing extra 8 Zone Extender PCBs (Part No. FF596R).
